scope: Synthetic embedded terminal demo only. No real game save, curriculum, learner progress or private conversation was sent or changed. No OpenAI API key or paid model call was used.
host: Regular ChatGPT web client (chatgpt.com), existing zombie-escape-study-game custom MCP plugin with OAuth, tools refreshed from Settings → Plugins → Manage → Refresh tools before the test.
relay: Managed relay restarted with the new tools (npm run bridge:stop / bridge:start); public tunnel started through the local start-public control and verified before the test.

steps.action: New chat asked ChatGPT to call open_study_terminal_demo and not get_study_handoff.
steps.observed: ChatGPT called open_study_terminal_demo once. The MCP App rendered in the conversation side panel. The app's ui/initialize was acknowledged and the UI showed 'Connected to regular ChatGPT. Send starts a host conversation turn.' with 0 demo keys. get_study_handoff was not called.

steps.action: Typed a partial answer ('I think the largest window is [2,3].') in the embedded UI and pressed Enter.
steps.observed: The UI called stage_study_terminal_turn, then sent its @study prompt through ui/message. The host accepted the message and a new model turn started without any chat typing. ChatGPT called reply_study_terminal_turn with complete:false; the UI rendered the Terminal AI follow-up asking for the shift explanation. Keys stayed at 0.

steps.action: Typed a complete answer covering the total, the subtract/add update, the invariant and the boundary; pressed Enter.
steps.observed: A second model turn started through ui/message. ChatGPT called reply_study_terminal_turn with complete:true. The UI showed '1 demo key · solved' and the chat showed 'Puzzle solved' and '1 demo key earned.' Exactly one key was awarded.

relayDiagnostics.note: tools/call includes the UI's bounded read_study_terminal_demo refreshes while a turn was pending. Sharing stayed disabled and no legacy worker session existed during the test (enabled:false, workerActive:false).
relayDiagnostics.redaction: Counts only; the relay never retains bodies, headers, credentials or OAuth identifiers.

limitations: The @study prompt sent through ui/message did not appear as a visible user bubble in the chat transcript; the model's reply was appended to the assistant's existing response. The turn still ran and called the connector tool.
This proves the host bridge and one-key completion for the synthetic demo. Real terminal gameplay, curriculum requests and the once-only game reward are not wired to this path.
ChatGPT's wording in the chat and in the tool text differed; only the reply_study_terminal_turn text reaches the UI.
Native ChatGPT Study Mode is not established by the @study prefix; this remains a regular conversation with a connector tool reply.
